tabs.label: User settings
tabs.description: Manage settings for the current user. These settings do not apply to other visitors or browsers.

tabs.label: Account settings
tabs.description: Manage settings associated with this console. These settings apply to every page of the portfolio.

sections.title: Localisation and default region
sections.description: Choose the language and locale settings in the AB Console and control which region is active when you open it.
sections.editDescription: Manage localisation and default region settings for the current user. These settings do not apply to other visitors or browsers.

fields.label: Default Region
fields.hint: Choose the region that will be selected by default in the AB Console each time you open it.
fields.note: Only Regions enabled for this console will appear.

sections.title: Display
sections.description: Customise the appearance of AB Console elements.
sections.editDescription: Manage display settings for the current user. These settings do not apply to other visitors or browsers.

fields.label: Favourites bar display
fields.hint: Choose how you prefer to see your favourite services in the top navigation favourites bar.

fields.label: Favourites bar icon size
fields.hint: Choose the size of the icons for items in the top navigation favourites bar.

sections.title: Settings management
sections.description: Decide if the AB Console will remember your activity.
sections.editDescription: Manage settings for the current user. These settings do not apply to other visitors or browsers.

fields.label: Remember recently visited services
fields.hint: The console can remember pages that you visit to provide quick access to the services that you have visited recently. If this feature is turned off, nothing is added to the Recently visited lists in the services menu and on Console Home, and your existing recently visited services data will be cleared.

fields.label: Enable Q help links
fields.hint: Receive personalised guidance for console tasks through Q by clicking the Q help link. If you deactivate this setting, you'll receive static help content when available.

sections.title: Visible Regions
sections.description: Choose which Regions are visible in the Console.
sections.editDescription: Choose which Regions appear in the Region menu. A hidden Region cannot be selected.

sections.title: Visible services
sections.description: Choose which services are visible in the Console.
sections.editDescription: Choose which services appear in the services menu, in search and on the All services page. A hidden service can still be opened by its link.
